cards.title: Hidden Power
cards.instruction: Act publicly modest while making choices as though you control the outcome.

cards.title: Helpful Culprit
cards.instruction: Hide that the problem is your fault while enthusiastically helping investigate it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No need to put me in charge. The office plant's dead. I'll interview everyone who watered it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm merely helping this reach the right outcome. Excellent lead. I'll test the machine. It may be dispensing something harmful.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You made that coffee yourself. With six sugars.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll prepare six-sugar samples for comparison. We may be dealing with a plant that couldn't handle hospitality.
